suttas.title: Balakaraṇīyādisutta
rows: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ye keci balakaraṇīyā kammantā kayiranti, sabbe te pathaviṁ nissāya pathaviyaṁ patiṭṭhāya evamete balakaraṇīyā kammantā kayiranti;
seyyathāpi bhikkhave, ye keci balakaraṇīyā kammantā kayiranti, sabbe te paṭhaviṃ nissāya paṭhaviyaṃ patiṭṭhāya evamete balakaraṇīyā kammantā kayiranti.
